people.name: Joseph
people.line: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

translations.web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,
translations.bsb: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
translations.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
translations.asv: And his father and his mother were marvelling at the things which were spoken concerning him;
